03 / Identity system

One geometry, seventeen cuts

The mark had to survive a 16px favicon and a full-bleed hero without being redrawn for either. One geometry, with cuts for cream, dark, accent and monochrome, plus dimensional treatments for the moments that earn them.

Restraint is the point. The identity carries one accent and one gesture, so the product can be loud in exactly one place and quiet everywhere else.

17marks drawn from one geometry
16pxsmallest cut that stays legible
1accent, used sparingly and on purpose
Dark, light and dimensional cutsFavicon to hero
04 / Design QA as engineering

The gate that caught what nobody saw

The design system passed every check while rendering wrong. Build passed. Typechecker passed. Tests passed. The class was in the HTML and the colour was not on screen: a token consumed through an invalid wrapper, so the browser dropped the declaration silently.

Source inspection could not see it, because a working declaration and a dead one look nearly identical. So I stopped reading source and asserted on computed style in a real browser. It found 118 dead declarations. Then the honest part: my first detector reported 80 false failures, because a browser serialises a colour-mix result differently from a plain colour. I had to fix the detector before I could trust the detection.

118dead declarations found
80false failures in my own first detector
3other gates that saw nothing at all

build            pass
typecheck        pass  0 errors
unit tests       pass  1,280+

// a green board is not evidence. the pixel is.

05 / Engineering

What sits underneath the pixels

A framework-agnostic multi-agent engine: council protocol, declarative workflow schema with validation, memory extraction and retrieval, injectable LLM and database ports. Hardened with quarantine, a token kill-switch, provider fallback and retry with backoff, all proven on live model runs.

Alongside it, a multi-broker trading platform with an LLM risk overlay holding veto authority over the rule engine. All trading results are backtested. No live capital was deployed.
